tags.name: slate-doc
tags.description: Root wrapper for a single printable assignment sheet.

tags.name: slate-header
tags.description: Title block at the top of the sheet (course/term, title, name/date fields).

tags.name: slate-boxnote
tags.description: A labeled box, e.g. for instructions or grading notes.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Heading text for the box. Defaults to "Notes" when omitted.

tags.name: slate-section
tags.description: Standalone single-line section marker, e.g. Objectives/Equipment/Procedure. Not a wrapper.

tags.name: slate-question
tags.description: Wrapper for a single graded question. Auto-numbered by slate-shared.js.

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Point value, rendered as "(N pts)" and summed into slate-score.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: Use "slate-objective" for unnumbered objective list items.

tags.name: slate-subquestion
tags.description: Lettered part (a, b, c, ...) inside a slate-question. Auto-lettered by slate-shared.js.

tags.name: slate-blank
tags.description: Fill-in-the-blank line. Do not append units after it - students must supply units themselves.

tags.name: slate-freeform
tags.description: Ruled lines for a free-response written answer.

attributes.name: lines
attributes.description: Number of ruled lines to draw. Default 3.

tags.name: slate-pagebreak
tags.description: Forces a real page break in print at this point in the document. No effect on screen, since screen isn't paginated.

tags.name: slate-workspace
tags.description: Open bordered box for students to show their work. Spans the full width of its container - the page, or a slate-answer-col when nested inside one.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Any CSS length, sets min-height. Default 1.5in.

tags.name: slate-answer-row
tags.description: Lays a slate-diagram and slate-answer-col side by side (wraps on narrow widths).

tags.name: slate-answer-col
tags.description: Right-hand column of subquestions used inside slate-answer-row.

tags.name: slate-diagram
tags.description: Wraps an iframe embedding a self-contained circuit diagram from diagrams/.

attributes.name: debug
attributes.description: Shows the diagram's bounding box border while tuning layout.

tags.name: slate-space
tags.description: Manual extra vertical gap between questions.

tags.name: slate-checklist
tags.description: Borderless multi-column checkbox grid, e.g. an equipment list.

tags.name: slate-check-item
tags.description: Single checkbox row inside a slate-checklist.

tags.name: slate-choices
tags.description: Row of multiple-choice options.

tags.name: slate-choice
tags.description: Single option inside slate-choices.

tags.name: slate-score
tags.description: Auto-computed total of every slate-question points="N" on the page. Place once at the end.

tags.name: slate-right
tags.description: Right-aligns a block, e.g. a labeled value line.

tags.name: slate-eq
tags.description: Italic math font styling for a variable or equation. Inline by default; add style="display: block;" to center a standalone equation line.

tags.name: slate-eq-caption
tags.description: Centered caption line under a slate-eq or figure, e.g. naming the equation or spec table above it.

tags.name: slate-frac
tags.description: Inline fraction. Wraps a slate-frac-num and slate-frac-den.

tags.name: slate-frac-num
tags.description: Numerator of a slate-frac.

tags.name: slate-frac-den
tags.description: Denominator of a slate-frac.

tags.name: slate-list
tags.description: Wrapper for a numbered (1, 2, 3, ...) list of steps, e.g. procedural instructions. Auto-numbered by slate-shared.js.

tags.name: slate-list-item
tags.description: Single item inside a slate-list.
